requirements_lines:
R-001 | The system shall update power dispatch commands at least every 1 second.
R-002 | The system shall maintain critical-load power during grid loss by entering island mode within 200 ms.
R-003 | The system shall limit battery charge/discharge current to configured maximums to prevent overcurrent events.
R-004 | The system shall prioritize critical loads over non-critical loads during capacity shortfalls.
R-005 | The system shall forecast site load and PV generation at 15-minute resolution for at least the next 24 hours.
R-006 | The system shall log all dispatch decisions with timestamp, inputs used, and resulting setpoints for audit purposes.
R-007 | The system shall provide an operator dashboard that shows real-time power flows and device status within 2 seconds of measurement.
